method: Exploratory parameter sensitivity; same 60 stratified questions as earlier evaluation, not held out.
cacheCaveat: Legacy cache records model name only. Six sampled vectors were re-embedded for compatibility; full historical provenance is unavailable.
futureDatePolicy: Main results preserve production negative ages. Separate clamp-to-zero control, and subset excluding entire questions with future candidates.
tieBreak: Original adapter candidate order; recency endpoint sorts age directly.
metrics: Macro-average chunk recall@5 and truncated reciprocal rank@5. Not answer accuracy or end-to-end latency.
